fix(render-event): a source's run names its key's failure, and failed sources get their own field (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.z7t)

The run each shell and file source names is Pending | Ok<Run> | Failed, so
the render event reads a key that failed before answering from the run
itself, not from a second map of policy faults rebuilt every render.
sourcesPending= keeps meaning not answered yet; sourcesFailed= names each
failed source by variable.
fix(render-event): a source that failed, or whose key failed, is named failed by its variable (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.z7t)

refactor(host): every renderer turn holds the session its event names (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.111) (#735)

* refactor(host): every renderer turn holds the session its event names, so no caller pairs the hold by hand (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.111)

The host's one turn path reads each event's session through one derivation,
which both the hold and the turn line's sid use. A hold only counts the turn;
activity is a request's alone, so a turn the collector's own deliveries start
never keeps a session nobody draws. effect-done names its effect's session.

* test(plugin-sources): an ask waits for its delivered turns to settle, and the hold cites its timing law (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.111)

* fix(collector): a click marks its session active as a request does, so the next sweep keeps a session someone just clicked (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.111)
